newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco says no smelter disruptions.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco says no smelter disruptions.

text.p: Pasminco Ltd said on Tuesday there would be no disruptions to its Port Pirie lead and zinc smelting operations in South Australia due to flooding of rail lines leading from its Broken Hill mine in New South Wales.

Pasminco said it was making plans for using alternate rail routes to ship concentrates from Broken Hill to Port Pirie at the normal rate of about 11,000 tonnes a week until railway repairs were completed.
The mine is located about 500 km from Port Pirie.
A Pasminco spokeswoman earlier on Tuesday told Reuters the smelter was drawing on stocks of lead and zinc concentrates on hand at the smelter.
About 37 km of railway line in north-eastern South Australia was washed away in the last three or four days due to the flooding, she said.
The Port Pirie smelter produces about 200,000 tonnes of lead and 38,000 tonnes of zinc annually.
